sn56.46:1.1: atthi bhikkhave lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā yatthapimesaṃ candimasuriyānaṃ evaṃmahiddhikānaṃ evaṃmahānubhāvānaṃ ābhāya nānubhontīti.
sn56.46:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn56.46:2.2: mahā vata so bhante andhakāro sumahā vata so bhante andhakāro
sn56.46:2.3: atthi nu kho bhante etamhā andhakārā añño andhakāro mahantataro ca bhayānakataro cāti.
sn56.46:2.4: atthi kho bhikkhu etamhā andhakārā añño andhakāro mahantataro ca bhayānakataro cāti.
sn56.46:3.1: katamo pana bhante etamhā andhakārā añño andhakāro ca bhayānakataro cāti.
sn56.46:3.2: ye hi keci bhikkhu samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti.
sn56.46:3.5: abhisaṅkharitvā jātandhakārampi papatanti jarandhakārampi papatanti maraṇandhakārampi papatanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsandhakārampi papatanti.
sn56.46:3.6: te na parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
sn56.46:4.1: ye ca kho keci bhikkhu samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti.
sn56.46:4.4: anabhisaṅkharitvā jātandhakārampi na papatanti jarandhakārampi na papatanti maraṇandhakārampi na papatanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsandhakārampi na papatanti.
sn56.46:4.5: te parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
sn56.46:5.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
